liability.title: ASC 842 Lease Liability Calculation in Excel: PV of Payments, ROU Asset, Monthly Interest #Shorts
liability.description:
Lease liability = present value of the remaining payments; ROU asset = liability + initial direct costs − incentives; interest = beginning liability × IBR ÷ 12, every month. Straight from the KDesk ASC 842 workbook.
Full walkthrough + workbook: https://kdeskaccounting.com/templates/asc842/
Free version: https://kdeskaccounting.gumroad.com/l/gljxc

rollforward.title: ASC 842 Lease Rollforward + Maturity Analysis in Excel (Footnote-Ready) #Shorts
rollforward.description:
Opening + additions − reductions = closing, split current vs. non-current, plus the maturity analysis table your footnote needs — produced by the KDesk ASC 842 workbook.
Full walkthrough + workbook: https://kdeskaccounting.com/templates/asc842/
